envelope.description: Project queue waits and enable concurrent admission

body.title: Project queue waits and enable concurrent admission
body.summary: Wire the admission-based outbox into the host and webview, then enable the v3 queue path with its compatible worker and runtime. Preserve existing queue recovery affordances and enforce the upgrade preflight.
acceptanceChecks: Visible rows explain same-chat order, retry delay, unavailable origin and full capacity using the same eligibility snapshot as admission. Free capacity and idle drafts show no unrelated blocking message.
No window can keep using the old singleton schema after cutover. Incompatible reopen and unsafe migration fail closed with a recoverable notice.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-outbox.test.ts: wait reason uses shared eligibility for FIFO, retries, origin and capacity
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-queue-outbox-host.test.ts: compatible v3 cutover and idle drafts with no unrelated blocker
